headline: Roche (SWX:ROP) Wins FDA Clearance And EU Backing For Two Key Treatments
summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) received FDA clearance for its cobas BV/CV assay for diagnosing bacterial vaginosis and Candida vaginitis in the United States. The European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommended approval of Susvimo, a ranibizumab eye implant, for neovascular age related macular degeneration in Europe. Roche Holding sits at the intersection of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, which gives the company multiple ways to respond as medical practice...
